name: shinchantw_cbt_week4_monetization_20260802_203311_852972
sql:
/* 首周前四日：商品、首充、复购、付费档位。SG 口径限定新加坡 Android/全体。 */
WITH Config AS (SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' tc_start, DATE '2026-08-01' tc_end, DATE '2026-05-08' sg_start),
TCB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" user_id FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SGB AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
SGC AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
SGA AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
M AS (SELECT '新加坡全体(iOS+Android)' grp,c.user_id FROM SGC c UNION ALL SELECT '新加坡Android',c.user_id FROM SGC c JOIN SGA a ON c.user_id=a.user_id),
P AS (
 SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" account_id,CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR) product_id,e."#event_time" pay_time,TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount AS DOUBLE)/COALESCE(x.exchange,1) amount
 FROM ta.v_event_18 e CROSS JOIN Config c LEFT JOIN TCB b ON e."#user_id"=b.user_id LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x ON e."$part_date"=x.ex_date AND e.pay_currency=x.currency
 WHERE e."$part_event"='charge' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.tc_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.tc_end AS VARCHAR) AND b.user_id IS NULL AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR),e."#event_time",TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount_usd AS DOUBLE)
 FROM ta.v_event_13 e CROSS JOIN Config c JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.user_id LEFT JOIN SGB b ON e."#user_id"=b.user_id
 WHERE e."$part_event"='charge' AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.sg_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.tc_start,c.tc_end),c.sg_start) AS VARCHAR) AND b.user_id IS NULL AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE) AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE)
),
R AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY grp,account_id ORDER BY pay_time) seq,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY grp,account_id) total_orders FROM P),
UserRevenue AS (SELECT grp,account_id,SUM(amount) revenue FROM P GROUP BY 1,2),
ProductAgg AS (SELECT grp,product_id,COUNT(*) orders,COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) buyers,SUM(amount) revenue,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN seq=1 THEN account_id END) first_buyers,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN seq>=2 THEN account_id END) repeat_buyers FROM R GROUP BY 1,2),
TierAgg AS (SELECT grp,CASE WHEN revenue<=10 THEN '01.(0,10]' WHEN revenue<=50 THEN '02.(10,50]' WHEN revenue<=100 THEN '03.(50,100]' WHEN revenue<=300 THEN '04.(100,300]' ELSE '05.(300,+]' END tier,COUNT(*) users,SUM(revenue) revenue FROM UserRevenue GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT 'product' "数据模块",grp "对比组",product_id "商品ID",orders "购买次数",buyers "购买人数",first_buyers "首充人数",repeat_buyers "复购人数",ROUND(revenue,2) "收入USD",ROUND(100.0*revenue/NULLIF(SUM(revenue) OVER(PARTITION BY grp),0),2) "收入占比(%)",NULL "付费档位",NULL "档位人数" FROM ProductAgg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'payer_tier',grp,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,ROUND(revenue,2),ROUND(100.0*revenue/NULLIF(SUM(revenue) OVER(PARTITION BY grp),0),2),tier,users FROM TierAgg
ORDER BY 1,2,8 DESC;
